title: Stowmark Overview
description: Stowmark snapshots, restores, operations, logs and traces. Generated by scripts/generate-dashboard.py.

panels.title: Last successful snapshot
panels.description: Time of the last create-snapshot without errors (Tempo search, up to 7 days).

panels.title: Successful snapshots
panels.description: Successful create-snapshot runs in the time range. Red when there are none.

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Operations without errors over all operations (the operation filter applies).

panels.title: Failed operations
panels.description: Commands and queries that ended with an error in the time range.

panels.title: Incomplete restores
panels.description: restore-snapshot runs with an error or with snapshot.is_success=false (Tempo search). Partial restores do not set the span status to error.

panels.title: Last snapshot size
panels.description: snapshot.total_size of the last successful create-snapshot.

panels.title: Size and files per snapshot
panels.description: Each point is a successful create-snapshot (Tempo search, up to 7 days).

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "create-snapshot" && status != error } | select(span.snapshot.total_size, span.snapshot.file_count)

panels.title: create-snapshot duration
panels.description: Duration of each create-snapshot (Tempo span); errors in red.

panels.title: Recent snapshots
panels.description: Latest create-snapshot runs and their attributes. Click a span to open its trace.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "create-snapshot" } | select(span.snapshot.id, span.snapshot.file_count, span.snapshot.total_size, span.snapshot.skipped_files, status)

panels.title: Recent restores
panels.description: restore-snapshot and restore-file runs. 'Complete' comes from snapshot.is_success: a partial restore does not set the span status to error. 'Files' is snapshot.total_files_restored.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "restore-snapshot|restore-file" } | select(span.snapshot.id, span.snapshot.total_files_restored, span.snapshot.total_files_failed, span.snapshot.is_success, status)

panels.title: Errors by operation
panels.description: Executions that ended with an error (Prometheus).

panels.title: Summary by operation
panels.description: Totals for the time range. Duration is the average (sum/count): Stowmark's histogram uses the default buckets (0, 5, 10… s), so quantiles are not meaningful.

targets.expr: round(sum by (operation_name, operation_type) (increase(stowmark_operation_executions_total{service_name="$service", operation_name=~"${operation:regex}", operation_status="error"}[$__range]))) or on (operation_name, operation_type) (0 * sum by (operation_name, operation_type) (increase(stowmark_operation_executions_total{service_name="$service", operation_name=~"${operation:regex}"}[$__range])))

sum by (operation_name, operation_type) (increase(stowmark_operation_duration_seconds_sum{service_name="$service", operation_name=~"${operation:regex}"}[$__range])) / sum by (operation_name, operation_type) (increase(stowmark_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name="$service", operation_name=~"${operation:regex}"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Average duration by operation
panels.description: Sum of durations / number of executions per interval (Prometheus).

targets.expr: sum by (detected_level) (count_over_time({service_name="$service"} | detected_level=~"${level:regex}" | command=~"${operation:regex}" or query=~"${operation:regex}" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Recent errors
panels.description: Error logs with the exception message. Click a trace ID to open the trace.

panels.title: Logs
panels.description: Stowmark logs filtered by level and operation. The metadata includes trace_id.

panels.title: Traces with errors
panels.description: Traces with at least one span in error (Tempo, up to 7 days).

panels.title: Recent traces
panels.description: Latest traces of the selected operations (Tempo, up to 7 days).
